sourceBaselineFindings.sourceOperation: Meinshausen2020 GHG forcing uses reference concentrations 277.15 ppm CO2, 731.41 ppb CH4 and 273.87 ppb N2O, then explicitly subtracts the evaluated 1750 ghg_forcing_offset.
sourceBaselineFindings.time: IGCC integer-labelled annual ERF versus retained FaIR boundary-pair annual means; compare only 1750-2014, not post-2014 SSP years as historical observations.
sourceBaselineFindings.unit: Both are W m-2; verified identity multiplier 1. No unit scaling estimated.
sourceBaselineFindings.allowedAlignment: For CO2/CH4/N2O only, subtract each series' own actual annual-1750 ERF; subtract model baselines memberwise before median. Report raw and changes separately.
sourceBaselineFindings.interpretationLimit: Annual-origin ERF change diagnostic, not exact conversion between nonlinear concentration-reference states, chemistry reconciliation or an acceptance score. This alignment does not improve the CO2 RMSE and no adjustment was optimized.
